segments.title: particular conditions and covered space
segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine reconciliation by Codex, reused non-author of both current originals. The complete causal-arising phrase dbang gis skye ba owns caused by; no isolated skye ba/caused dictionary claim is made. Generally speaking and about/about/on are established lexical renderings. The complete der thal formula owns This too is a fact at phrase depth. The two negative-scope yang occurrences own at all and the clause-joining and; the initial topic yang and time/place conjunction stay unwrapped. Three med predicates own their separate nothing/nothing/not exist. Covered space is positively attested in HTG2016; comparative darkness does not justify changing it. Supplied participants, modal can, articles and naming language remain unwrapped. No source wording or hgm_gloss is changed. The first phyir and first for stay unwrapped because the concrete grounds are reorganized through the English colon; final phyir owns the second for. This distributed causal restructuring does not assert absence of meaning.

Omit first phyir [196,201) / first for [91,94) as distributed causal restructuring (C05-273-CAUSAL-01). Tibetan phyir closes the concrete sun/cold and moon/hot grounds for general non-occurrence. English first for introduces that general non-occurrence as a reason for exceptional circumstances; the colon introduces the concrete grounds. Positive HTG2016 entry11962 phyir/for and shared discourse intent do not establish this local d6 ownership. The contribution is distributed, not absent: no null, reassignment or source change. Final p28 remains the separate final premise link. All three med retain separate exact ranges.

source_row.acip: DE YANG YUL DUS KHYAD PAR CAN DE DAG GI DBANG GIS SKYE BA YIN GYI SPYIR DE LTAR SKYE BA MA YIN TE, NYI MA'I STENG DU GRANG BA'I REG BYA YANG MED, ZLA BA'I STENG DU TSA BA'I REG BYA YANG MED PA'I PHYIR, DER THAL, NYI MA'I STENG DU MUN PA'I RDZAS MED PA'I PHYIR,
source_row.wylie: de yang yul dus khyad par can de dag gi dbang gis skye ba yin gyi spyir de ltar skye ba ma yin te, nyi ma'i steng du grang ba'i reg bya yang med, zla ba'i steng du tsha ba'i reg bya yang med pa'i phyir, der thal, nyi ma'i steng du mun pa'i rdzas med pa'i phyir
source_row.english: All of this is caused by the extraordinary circumstances of the particular time and place, for generally speaking it never happens this way: there is nothing at all about the sun that can feel cold, and nothing about the moon that can feel hot. This too is a fact, for there does not exist on the sun any case of that substance we call "covered space."
